title: Language Detoxification with Attribute-Discriminative Latent Space

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text continuations generated from the RealToxicityPrompts dataset using the Perspective API to calculate Expected Maximum Toxicity and Toxicity Probability. Also includes evaluation on dialogue datasets (ToxiChat and DiaSafety) using classifiers for bad words and offensiveness, supplemented by human evaluation.

Measuring the 'identity attack' dimension using the Perspective API on generated text continuations, and evaluating the proportion of 'bias opinion' generated in conversational responses using the DiaSafety dialogue dataset.
